fieldValues.title: RFC-034 Rev 5: execute the container-plane ruling
fieldValues.summary: Drafts RFC-034 Revision 5, executing rfc-decision-0750c62f (Container is a declared selection on the expression plane; contains is the part-of tree) via the owner six-point list on srs#267: adopts Changes B/C as drafted, renames per rfc-decision-92d2da05, rewrites Change E against the current discovery-query/container-subset surface (srs#525), states the one-way-door contains-maintenance mitigation, notes design-capture-directory-kind-scopes graduates alongside acceptance, and backfills a Charter alignment section.
fieldValues.body: PR https://github.com/the-greenman/srs/pull/616 (branch claude/serene-johnson-nmcb1z). Doc-only Draft revision to an unaccepted RFC; no canonical records or schemas change. Both gates green by exit code; no new check was added so nothing to prove red-then-green. gate:owner-merge — stops at the PR, owner decides acceptance separately.
